contract.name: Winter 2026/27 – Special Offer SPO1 – China, Japan & Far East markets
contract.tax_note: Net rates in USD, non-commissionable, inclusive of applicable government taxes and levies
contract.child_policy_text: Children below 6 years FOC and 7-12 years 50% of the meal rate (max 02 children) sharing parents (offer document). Supplements summary (Summer 26 – Summer 27): below 6.99 years free of charge; 7-11.99 years 50% of the meal supplement sharing parents' room (max 02 children); extra bed USD 15 (Negombo: 7-11.99 years USD 42 per night for an extra bed with breakfast within Deluxe or Superior Deluxe based on availability; extra bed USD 30; Amethyst extra bed USD 12).
contract.cancellation_text: Bookings below 05 rooms: 14 days release 01 April – 20 December (excluding 01 – 31 August, which is 30 days); exceptions: up to 1 room reduction depending on occupancy 7 days prior to arrival with no cancellation fee. 30 days release 21 December – 31 March; exceptions: reduction of up to 1 room allowed until 14 days prior to arrival with no cancellation fee. Group bookings of 06 rooms & above: 30 days release 01 April – 20 December (excluding 01 – 31 August, which is 45 days); exception: 1-2 rooms reduction depending on occupancy 14 days prior to arrival with no cancellation fee. 45 days release 21 December – 31 March; exceptions: 1-2 rooms reduction depending on occupancy up to 14 days prior to arrival with no cancellation fee. No cancellation percentage is printed: 100% inside the release period entered. Reservations, amendments, cancellations: ashmres@aitkenspence.lk
contract.terms_text: The offer is valid for stays completed within the period of 01st November 2026 – 30th April 2027. Children below 6 years FOC and 7-12 years 50% of the meal rate (max 02 children) sharing parents. All rates and supplements are on net in USD currency and non-commissionable. The offer will not be applicable for any existing bookings and only be valid for new bookings commencing from the day on which the addendum was sent; amendments will not be accepted. All other supplements will remain as per the original Winter 26/27 contract. All rates are inclusive of applicable government taxes and levies as may be amended from time to time. Rates are subject to revision during the term of this contract. Please mention the special rate on the booking voucher in order for it to be applicable.
contract.voucher_note: Please mention the special rate (rate code) on the booking voucher in order for it to be applicable.
